## Freed v26.10.601-dev

Local Kev classification, labeled comparisons, and restored annotation text

### Features

- Choose Kev or Jev in AI settings and compare read-only Library classification scores. Kev uses a separate local service and abstains on uncertain answers without cloud fallback
- Run six labeled examples on each classifier to compare accuracy, decision coverage and latency

### Fixes

- Saved annotation text now loads through authenticated storage; incomplete or stale note replacements are refused
- Show search failures with retry controls instead of presenting them as empty results
- Keep the selected classifier and entered settings when pausing a model download fails
- Update security dependencies and reduce Darwin filesystem admission overhead
- Keep the iOS Home Screen toolbar sharp

### Follow-ups

- Opening this build upgrades local annotation storage from catalog 1 or 2 to 4 or 5. Older clients refuse upgraded storage; recovery requires a compatible build
- Kev thresholds are provisional. Classification scores remain a Settings preview and do not change saved classifications or feed filters
- The small labeled evaluation does not establish model parity or quality on your feed
- Installed native UI acceptance and Windows authenticated-range annotation hydration remain separate verification work

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
